welcome_page.title: Car – Comfort
welcome_page.description:
Comfort, delays and parking when you travel by car.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Compared with other ways of getting around, how comfortable is the car for you?
When you are held up on a car trip, how stressed do you feel?
questions.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

questions.text: Do traffic jams make you change your route or the time you leave?

options.text: Always: I plan my trips to avoid them

questions.text: How hard is it to find a parking space where you go?
questions.help: Think of the places you drive to most often.

options.text: Not for me: I don't drive

questions.text: When parking is hard, what do you usually do?

options.text: I still go, but it's slower or more stressful
I change my route or where I go
I put off, avoid or cancel some trips
I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on foot)

it.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: Rispetto agli altri modi di spostarsi, quanto è comoda per te l'auto?
it.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quando un viaggio in auto subisce blocchi o ritardi, quanto stress provi?
it.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Per esempio code, scontri o lavori in corso.
it.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: Le code ti fanno cambiare percorso o orario di partenza?
it.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: Sempre: organizzo gli spostamenti per evitarle
it.#How hard is it to find a parking space: Quanto è difficile trovare parcheggio nei posti dove vai?
it.#Think of the places you drive to most o: Pensa ai posti dove vai più spesso in auto.
it.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quando è difficile parcheggiare, cosa fai di solito?
it.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ci vado lo stesso, ma è più lento o più stressante
it.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Rimando, evito o annullo alcuni spostamenti
it.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. autobus, a piedi)
it.#How much do charging points affect whet: Quanto contano i punti di ricarica nella scelta di usare un’auto elettrica?
it.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Non mi riguarda: il mio veicolo non è elettrico
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Comfort, delays and parking <b>when:
Comfort, ritardi e parcheggio quando viaggi in auto.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: À quel point la voiture est-elle confortable pour vous, par rapport aux autres moyens de se déplacer ?
fr.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quand un trajet en voiture prend du retard, quel stress ressentez-vous ?
fr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Par exemple des embouteillages, des collisions ou des travaux.
fr.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: Les embouteillages vous font-ils changer d'itinéraire ou d'heure de départ ?
fr.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: Toujours : je planifie mes trajets pour les éviter
fr.#How hard is it to find a parking space: À quel point est-il difficile de trouver une place de stationnement là où vous allez ?
fr.#Think of the places you drive to most o: Pensez aux endroits où vous allez le plus souvent en voiture.
fr.#Not for me: I don't drive: Cela ne me concerne pas : je ne conduis pas
fr.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quand il est difficile de se garer, que faites-vous habituellement ?
fr.#It doesn't change my plans: Cela ne change pas mes projets
fr.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: J'y vais quand même, mais c'est plus long ou plus stressant
fr.#I change my route or where I go: Je change d'itinéraire ou de destination
fr.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Je reporte, j'évite ou j'annule certains trajets
fr.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus, à pied)
fr.#How much do charging points affect whet: Dans quelle mesure les bornes de recharge influencent-elles votre choix d’utiliser une voiture électrique ?
fr.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Cela ne me concerne pas : mon véhicule n'est pas électrique
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Comfort, delays and parking <b>when:
Le confort, les retards et le stationnement lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: Wie bequem ist das Auto für Sie im Vergleich zu anderen Fortbewegungsarten?

de.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Zum Beispiel Stau, Zusammenstöße oder Baustellen.

de.#Not for me: I don't drive: Trifft auf mich nicht zu: Ich fahre nicht selbst
de.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Was tun Sie in der Regel, wenn das Parken schwierig ist?
de.#It doesn't change my plans: Es ändert nichts an meinen Plänen
de.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ich fahre trotzdem hin, aber es dauert länger oder ist stressiger
de.#I change my route or where I go: Ich ändere meine Route oder mein Ziel
de.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Ich verschiebe, vermeide oder streiche manche Fahrten
de.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Ich nehme stattdessen ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Bus, zu Fuß)

de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>Comfort, delays and parking <b>when:
Komfort, Verzögerungen und Parken, wenn Sie mit dem Auto unterwegs sind.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft und an keine Behörde weitergegeben.

tr.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: Diğer ulaşım yollarına kıyasla otomobil sizin için ne kadar rahat?
tr.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Araba yolculuğunda gecikmeye uğradığınızda ne kadar stres yaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Örneğin trafik sıkışıklığı, çarpışmalar veya yol çalışmaları.
tr.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: Trafik sıkışıklığı güzergâhınızı veya yola çıkma saatinizi değiştirtiyor mu?
tr.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: Her zaman: yolculuklarımı onlardan kaçınacak şekilde planlarım
tr.#How hard is it to find a parking space: Gittiğiniz yerlerde park yeri bulmak ne kadar zor?
tr.#Think of the places you drive to most o: En sık otomobille gittiğiniz yerleri düşünün.
tr.#Not for me: I don't drive: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Araç kullanmıyorum
tr.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Park etmek zor olduğunda genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Yine de giderim ama daha yavaş veya daha stresli olur
tr.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Bazı yolculukları ertelerim, yapmaktan kaçınırım veya iptal ederim
tr.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Bunun yerine başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otobüs, yürüyerek)
tr.#How much do charging points affect whet: Şarj noktaları elektrikli araba kullanıp kullanmamanızı ne kadar etkiliyor?
tr.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Aracım elektrikli değil
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Comfort, delays and parking <b>when:
Arabayla yolculuk ederken konfor, gecikmeler ve park etme.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

fa.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: در مقایسه با روش‌های دیگر رفت‌وآمد، خودرو برای شما چقدر راحت است؟
fa.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: وقتی در سفر با خودرو معطل می‌شوید، چقدر احساس تنش می‌کنید؟
fa.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثلاً ترافیک سنگین، برخورد خودروها یا کار در جاده.
fa.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: آیا ترافیک سنگین باعث می‌شود مسیر یا زمان حرکت خود را تغییر دهید؟
fa.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: همیشه: سفرهایم را طوری برنامه‌ریزی می‌کنم که از آن دوری کنم
fa.#How hard is it to find a parking space: پیدا کردن جای پارک در جاهایی که می‌روید چقدر سخت است؟
fa.#Think of the places you drive to most o: به جاهایی فکر کنید که بیشتر با خودرو به آن‌ها می‌روید.
fa.#Not for me: I don't drive: مربوط به من نیست: رانندگی نمی‌کنم
fa.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: وقتی پیدا کردن جای پارک سخت است، معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: باز هم می‌روم، اما کندتر یا با تنش بیشتر
fa.#I change my route or where I go: مسیر یا مقصد خود را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم، از آن‌ها دوری می‌کنم یا لغو می‌کنم
fa.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: به جای آن با روش دیگری می‌روم (مثلاً اتوبوس، پیاده)
fa.#How much do charging points affect whet: ایستگاه‌های شارژ چقدر بر استفاده شما از خودرو برقی اثر می‌گذارند؟
fa.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: مربوط به من نیست: وسیله من برقی نیست
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Comfort, delays and parking <b>when:
راحتی، تأخیر و جای پارک هنگام سفر با خودرو.

شرکت داوطلبانه است و می‌توانید به هر پرسشی پاسخ ندهید. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند و به هیچ نهاد دولتی فرستاده نمی‌شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید

hu.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: A közlekedés más módjaihoz képest mennyire kényelmes Önnek az autó?

hu.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ettől még elmegyek, de lassabb vagy stresszesebb
hu.#I change my route or where I go: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy az úti célt
hu.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Néhány utat elhalasztok, elkerülök vagy lemondok
hu.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Inkább más módon megyek (pl. busszal, gyalog)

hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.

Kényelem, késések és parkolás autós utazás közben.

A részvétel önkéntes, és bármelyik kérdést kihagyhatja. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez, és semmilyen hatósághoz nem kerülnek.

الراحة والتأخيرات والمواقف عند التنقل بالسيارة.
